items.text: After B.Pharm you can work in hospital or retail pharmacy, quality, regulatory affairs, clinical research or sales, study further through M.Pharm or an MBA, or build towards your own licensed pharmacy, and the strongest growth usually comes from a specialisation or from ownership.
Each has different rules, costs and timelines.
Check the pharmacy council, state drug authority and exam pages.
